usage: A common countable noun for shrubs and bushy plants in gardening or landscape description.
Often used in plant labels, park descriptions, and school science contexts; it sounds neutral and standard.
Can refer to one shrub or a group of shrubs depending on context, so the article or quantity word gives the number.
Pairs naturally with words about planting, trimming, and garden design, such as 修剪 and 種植.
